name: comp-65
title: Muted Background Textarea
blurb: Textarea with muted gray background and no border.
description: A textarea styled with a muted gray background, transparent border, and no shadow. Creates a softer, less prominent appearance.
use_when: Secondary or supporting text fields where you want less visual prominence.
avoid_when: You need the textarea to stand out or have a clear border.
a11y: Label linked to textarea. Styling is purely visual and doesn't affect functionality.
